reason: The cited evidence discusses Al₂O₃ formation in Ti–Al and Nb–Al intermetallics, not in BCC refractory high-entropy alloys like HfNbTaTiZr, and provides no data on mechanical property retention or scale adhesion in this system. The key premises about selective oxidation, microstructural stability, and property preservation are therefore unsupported by the provided passages.
premises: Al addition selectively oxidizes to form protective Al₂O₃ scale in refractory alloys
Minor Al does not disrupt BCC solid-solution microstructure
Alumina scale reduces oxygen ingress and oxidation kinetics
Mechanical properties (ductility, yield strength) are preserved after Al addition
Alumina scale is adherent and continuous under the specified conditions
